_about: Place refinements of 2026-11-02 (the owner: add a centre of Torah in New York to the journey). Only the `location` text of seven sages (five first; the Rebbe 335 and Heschel 152 added later the same day on the owner's decision: with a city in place of the second country the city pins them, which is his intent) whose text held the country "ארה"ב" alone (or beside Europe / Israel) was changed, each to the city the sources give; nothing was moved to New York without a source. before/after are the sheet cell and both data.json copies. Wikipedia quotes were read from the API (action=query&prop=extracts&explaintext) at the revision recorded; paper quotes are in nextjs-app/public/research/<id>.json. `not_changed` records what was considered and left. Generated by the session; the test checks the shape and that each node's location equals `after`.
